userStories.title: Add 'review' to the LoopPhase enum and parser
userStories.description: As the sidecar poll loop, I need 'review' to be a first-class LoopPhase so that a phase:review state file round-trips through parseStateFile and the loop can dispatch on it.
acceptanceCriteria: 'review' is a member of the LoopPhase union type and of the LOOP_PHASES parser array in src/commands/status.ts. [oracle: grep -q "'review'" src/commands/status.ts]
parseStateFile round-trips a phase:review state file (phase === 'review' after parse), and rejects it before this change. [oracle: bun test test/commands/status.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: Single file: src/commands/status.ts (LoopPhase union L130, LOOP_PHASES array L133, parseStateFile L345/L375). The loop-state template vendor/cam-loop.local.md.tmpl already carries `phase: {{PHASE}}`, so NO template change is needed for the phase field itself (spec gotcha). This is the types/config foundation US-003/US-004 depend on. Precedent: 'shipping'/'planning' were added the same way (docs/adr/0006). Add a status.test.ts case asserting the phase:review round-trip; sweep it red-against-main first (it must fail before the enum gains 'review').

userStories.title: Make cam review a thin signal-writer gated on sidecar liveness
userStories.description: As the operator, I need `cam review` to write phase:review to the loop state file and gate on sidecar liveness (like cam plan and cam ship) so that manual review is driven by the sidecar instead of a send-keys thin-proxy.
acceptanceCriteria: runReview writes phase:review to .claude/cam-loop.local.md via writeStateFile (force), preserving all other loop-state fields, instead of injecting /cam-review via send-keys. [oracle: bun test test/commands/review.test.ts]

cam review gates on sidecar liveness via sidecarLivenessGate (src/commands/sidecar-gate.ts) and refuses with an operator message when no sidecar is alive, mirroring runPlan and runShip. [oracle: bun test test/commands/review.test.ts]
No --permission-mode CLI flag is introduced. [oracle: bun test test/commands/no-permission-mode-flag.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: src/commands/review.ts (currently a 207-line send-keys thin-proxy; collapse it to the plan/ship signal-writer shape). Mirror src/commands/plan.ts exactly: import writeStateFile + renderStateFile from status.ts, import sidecarLivenessGate from ./sidecar-gate.ts, expose an injectable writeFn defaulting to writeStateFile (plan.ts:44/53/205). Gate order matches plan/ship: sidecarLivenessGate first, then write. Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for 'signal-writer'/'sidecar' before coding. Gotcha (spec): a standalone phase:review requires an active prd.json + a cam branch, the same precondition as the in-context path; keep the gate consistent with plan/ship.

userStories.title: Dispatch runReviewPhaseFn from the sidecar poll loop on phase:review
userStories.description: As the sidecar supervisor, I need runSidecarLoop to call runReviewPhaseFn exactly when the read phase is review so that a phase:review signal drives a review round, mirroring the shipping and planning branches.
acceptanceCriteria: runSidecarLoop dispatches an injected runReviewPhaseFn exactly when readLoopPhaseFn() returns 'review', and never for other phases, mirroring the 'shipping' and 'planning' branches (loop.ts:2222/2247). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
A throwing injected runReviewPhaseFn cannot crash the outer loop (outer guard, mirroring the planning branch at loop.ts:2223). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/loop.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: src/supervisor/loop.ts. Add runReviewPhaseFn?: () => void | Promise<void> to RunSidecarLoopOptions next to runPlanPhaseFn (L2114) and runShipPhaseFn (L2133); add the dispatch branch next to the planning (L2222) and shipping (L2247) branches with the same throwing-fn outer guard. Design intent anchored in FLOW.md: cam review is listed among the signal-writer thin-proxies (FLOW.md L223) and the sidecar decideNextAction/review lifecycle (FLOW.md L390-398); the orch NARRATES the handback and never drives implement/review itself (FLOW.md L398-399). Add a loop.test.ts case that injects runReviewPhaseFn and asserts it fires only on phase:review; sweep red-against-main.

userStories.title: Wire the production review phase closure driving one makeReviewDispatch round
userStories.description: As the sidecar, I need a production review-phase closure that drives exactly one makeReviewDispatch round using the existing autonomous review machinery and resets phase to idle even on failure, so that manual review reaches the codex reviewer backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The production review phase closure drives exactly one makeReviewDispatch round (one reviewer verdict) and resets phase to idle in a finally block even when the dispatch throws. [oracle: bun test test/commands/sidecar.test.ts]

The review phase resolves its reviewer backend via readPhaseBackend('reviewer'), so a project.toml [phase] reviewer=codex reaches the codex reviewer path (validated by the code path, not a committed config flip). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

Fix-story burn-down is NOT auto-chained: one phase:review equals one round, then phase returns to idle for the orchestrator to narrate and drive cam next. [oracle: bun test test/commands/sidecar.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: src/commands/sidecar.ts. Build makeProductionReviewPhaseFn mirroring makeProductionShipPhaseFn (sidecar.ts:1314-1361) and makeProductionPlanPhaseFn: close over makeReviewDispatch (src/supervisor/review.ts:314; it already resolves readPhaseBackend('reviewer') at L354 and reaches the codex backend via selectAdapter) and reset phase to idle in a finally. Wire it into runReviewPhaseFn (RunSidecarLoopOptions, from US-003). Gotcha (spec): makeReviewDispatch operates on prd.json (roundsCompleted, US-R fix-stories) and requires an active prd.json + cam branch. CAM-405 gotcha: makeReviewDispatch + backend tests read the live project.toml; keep reviewer=claude committed on the branch (flipping to codex breaks 42 tests in CI with codex-auth-failed). Design intent: FLOW.md L390-398 (sidecar drives one review round, returns terminal verdict; orch narrates). Precedent ADRs: docs/adr/0009 (ship phase deterministic runner), docs/adr/0024 (phase is the resume discriminator).
